# Preserve legacy hashed folders when accepting Unicode file names

The current store test discovers a legacy 1ad41a64 file whose summary names it test τ, alongside a new un-hashed test π file. It asserts both display names and physical leaves and runs against both pluggable stores. Preserve compatibility discovery while avoiding unnecessary non-ASCII hashing on Windows; illegal characters still follow platform rules. These observations are scoped to the cited accepted source and historical changes. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run.

Scope: mailnews/local/test.
